label: Food waste charged by weight at an RFID machine
appliesTo: Apartment complexes using RFID machines, where the district operates that system. Bag and paid-tag systems exist alongside it in the same city, so the machine is not the default.
why: The only part of household waste that is billed by weight rather than by container, which makes draining moisture an actual line item rather than tidiness.

history.source: Incheon Metropolitan City — volume-based food waste charges, July 2026
history.note: Range across districts. Two families a few kilometres apart may be on a bag, a tag or a machine.
